company.name: Ledger Investing
company.shortDescription: Ledger Investing is an online marketplace powering interactions between investors and insurance carriers.
company.description: Ledger Investing is an online marketplace powering interactions between investors and insurance carriers. It facilitates access to Insurance-Linked Securities (ILS) investor capital, leveraging innovative data infrastructure and analytics to streamline transactions.

productsAndServices.description: A marketplace connecting insurers, reinsurers, MGAs, and fronting carriers with institutional capital for casualty insurance risk transactions.
productsAndServices.name: Casualty Insurance-Linked Securities (ILS) Marketplace

productsAndServices.description: Brokerage and placement services for casualty insurance-linked securities, including sourcing risks, arranging investors, and placing structured insurance transactions.
productsAndServices.name: Casualty ILS Broking and Placement

productsAndServices.description: Advisory and structuring services that convert casualty insurance risk and premium cash flows into capital-market and reinsurance solutions.
productsAndServices.name: Casualty ILS Structuring and Advisory

productsAndServices.description: A securities broker-dealer and placement agent focused on insurance structured finance, including casualty ILS distribution and transaction execution.
productsAndServices.name: Ledger Capital Markets

productsAndServices.description: Investment management for casualty insurance-linked securities, including dedicated funds and managed exposure to insurance risk portfolios.
productsAndServices.name: Casualty ILS Asset Management

productsAndServices.description: Distribution and secondary-market services for transferring and placing existing casualty insurance-linked securities and related insurance risk positions.
productsAndServices.name: Secondary Trading and Distribution of Casualty ILS
